title: index.md must be fetchable, non-empty, and non-erroring
untested_rationale: checkPresence('index-md', INDEX_MD_URL, ...) (validate-llms-txt.mjs) emits this bare id under three distinct conditions -- a thrown fetch error, a non-2xx HTTP status, and an empty body -- and takes the id as a parameter rather than a literal, so it cannot be exercised by a pure-function input. Covered instead by the production smoke suite's prod-domain route assertions (audits.yaml B1, the same incident class as llms-full-txt above).

spec.name: llms.txt (llmstxt.org)
spec.normative_quote: index.md has no formal spec of its own -- it is a CloudFront-only artifact this repo composes and serves; this id covers its own operational presence/emptiness handling.
spec.note: No spec clause applies -- conformance_testable is false by construction, matching rule_class: operational.
spec.verification_note: clause n/a -- rule_class: operational. normative_quote is a self-authored statement about the ABSENCE of external spec coverage for this transport/fetch/presence condition; there is no external normative clause to transcribe or verify against a source.

applicability: N/A -- fires on a transport or emptiness failure, not on parsed content.
